title: DR1's entry action reads "Create a new notification"; the frontend labels the same button "Start a new notification" and renders it as a start button.

finding.frontend: Under the heading and the service description sits a green start button reading "Start a new notification" with the start-button chevron (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/dashboard/copy/copy.en.js:7, and the isStartButton flag at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/dashboard/template.njk:32).
finding.prototype: DR1 puts the same action directly under the heading, labelled "Create a new notification", as an ordinary primary button with no chevron (app/views/dashboard.html:33-37).
finding.difference: Change the button text to "Create a new notification" and drop the start-button treatment, so the dashboard's entry action is a plain primary button. The start-button pattern belongs on a service start page, and DR1's dashboard is not one — it is a landing page for a signed-in user who already has notifications. The label also has to change in the Welsh copy file alongside the English one (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/dashboard/copy/copy.cy.js).
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding "Start a new notification" as the entry-action label anywhere in DR1's root dashboard view.
finding.correction: Nothing to correct. Both labels are in the pictures and both page models. The chevron claim is the part worth checking rather than assuming, and it holds two ways: DR1's govukButton call passes no isStartButton flag, and evidence/prototype@491b3926/page/dr1-dashboard.png shows a plain green rectangle where evidence/frontend@76a864ba/page/fe-dashboard-populated.png shows the chevron. The frontend's captured form records the button classes as govuk-button govuk-button--start.
